checkpoints.description: [1/1] A1 shipped: server/shellEnv.ts, shellEnvPassthrough config field through the config route, bash tool and MCP stdio first start and restart use the scrubbed environment, isProtectedConfigPath in server/rules.ts with the rule engine asking and headless --yes refusing, ADRs 072 to 083, README tree and docs/FEATURES.md. 21 new tests written first (6 shell-env unit, 5 protected-path unit, 6 env-leak integration incl a mutation-checked MCP restart case, 4 protected-config headless, 1 api), the previous scratch probe is now a regression test with fabricated values, tsc clean, 510 tests across 104 files pass, 10/10 gates on the first run. Hot path: one config read and one small env copy per bash call only; read tools unchanged, agent-perf passed. No UI file changed so no UI task. checklists: passed

handoff.next: A2 live-model result needs a model endpoint or key from the user

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan A milestone A3 server part: read .agents/skills with precedence atelier then agents then claude, and add an ask decision to permission rules ordered deny then ask then allow with an explicitAsk flag on the approver so headless --yes cannot satisfy it; ADRs 084 and 085

impact_assessment.why: Skills written for Codex Antigravity and Vibe live in .agents/skills and did not appear, and a broad allow rule could not exclude one dangerous subcommand while four peers order rules deny ask allow
impact_assessment.benefits: Shared skill folders work across tools and users can pre-approve a command family except the risky member
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rules decision gains ask, the approve callback gains a fourth parameter, skills gain a third folder; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: existing rules files load unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Eleven tests written first with the end to end ones mutation-checked, Settings UI and client types deliberately untouched so no UI task is needed, documented limit that ask rules are config-only until the UI batch

checkpoints.description: [1/1] A3 server part shipped: .agents/skills read with precedence atelier then agents then claude sharing the 30 skill cap, ask decision in rules ordered deny then ask then allow, explicitAsk on the approver so headless --yes refuses a call a rule said to ask about, approval reason names the rule, docs/FEATURES.md, ADRs 084 and 085. 16 new tests (5 skills folder integration, 5 ask unit, 6 ask end to end), the end to end ones mutation-checked by disabling the ask branch which turned the two key tests red and restoring turned them green, tsc clean, 10/10 gates first run. No src file changed so no UI task. Not done from A3: nested and ancestor AGENTS.md chain and Claude-style rule string import, deferred because the nested case needs on-demand loading design. checklists: passed

handoff.next: A4 token streaming and ACP, or A2 when a model is available

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan A milestone A4 first half: live token deltas on an in-memory per-session channel (server/liveStream.ts), an onEvent observer on collectProvider, the agent loop publishing text.delta, and the SSE endpoint forwarding them without an id and serialised with durable frames; ADR-086. The ACP agent and the UI drawing of deltas are separate tasks

impact_assessment.why: Provider output was collected whole so no client could show an answer as it formed, and it is the prerequisite for a good ACP agent
impact_assessment.benefits: Clients and an in-process ACP agent can show text as it is produced without the cost and replay problems of logging every token
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new SSE event type text.delta and an onEvent option; dependency: none; concurrency: SSE writes from two sources are serialised through one promise chain and unsubscribed on abort; state: none, deltas are not persisted
impact_assessment.mitigation: Ten tests written first, a faulty subscriber and a client disconnect both covered, per-delta cost measured directly at 3.5 ns with no subscriber and 20 ns with one because whole-run P95 is too noisy to show it, no src file changed

checkpoints.description: [1/1] A4 first half shipped: server/liveStream.ts, collectProvider onEvent, text.delta published from the agent loop, SSE forwarding without id serialised with durable frames and unsubscribed on abort, docs and ADR-086, README tree. 10 new tests written first (5 unit, 5 integration covering deltas adding up to the stored answer, nothing written to the event log, wire frames without ids, and a client disconnect), existing 24 api tests still pass, tsc clean, 10/10 gates first run. G-006: per-delta cost measured directly because whole-run P95 is too noisy on this machine: 3.5 ns with no subscriber, 20 ns with one subscriber, for answers that take hundreds of milliseconds to produce. No src file changed so no UI task; the UI does not draw deltas yet. checklists: passed

handoff.next: ACP agent over stdio on top of liveStream, or A2 when a model is available

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan A milestone A4 second half: an Agent Client Protocol v1 agent as atelier acp, hand-rolled under server/acp (JSON-RPC line peer, pure mappings, run bridge) instead of the SDK whose licence is unverified, bridging sessions to conversations, turns to runs, live deltas to message chunks, tool results to tool-call updates and durable approvals to session/request_permission, with cancellation, stop reasons, image and workspace link prompts, and a clean exit; ADR-087

impact_assessment.why: Atelier was reachable only through its browser UI and run command while Kilo and Vibe can be launched by editors over ACP, and the read of the ACP v1 pages showed the minimal agent is small
impact_assessment.benefits: Editors that speak ACP can use atelier as their agent without an extension, with approvals handled in the editor
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new command and protocol surface to keep current, src/types.ts RuleConfig decision type gains ask so the shared helper typechecks; dependency: none added; concurrency: one turn per session enforced, peer answers requests without blocking so cancel is processed during a turn, writes serialised by a single stream; state: sessions live in memory for the connection and conversations are ordinary stored ones
impact_assessment.mitigation: Eight peer tests, eight mapping and two message tests and sixteen agent tests written first, permission handling mutation-checked, real-process end to end over stdio confirming JSON-only stdout and exit 0, no claim of editor or live-model verification, unsupported features listed in the docs and ADR

handoff.next: commit ACP slice, then A5 headless

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: atelier run --max-turns n caps model turns; documented exit codes in --help (G-009)

impact_assessment.why: G-009: the agent must drive atelier headless with bounded, predictable runs
impact_assessment.benefits: A run can be capped per call; exit codes are documented for scripts
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new optional flag, default unchanged at 40; dependency: runner passes FULL_PROFILE with a lower maxSteps; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default path unchanged, mutation-checked test, validation rejects 0/NaN/over 200

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: atelier run --output-format text|json|stream-json; stream-json prints each session event then a result line (G-009)

impact_assessment.why: G-009: the agent needs a live machine-readable view of a headless run
impact_assessment.benefits: An agent or script can follow a run as JSON Lines and parse one final result
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new flag, --json unchanged; dependency: headless polls listEvents every 50ms on its own handle; concurrency: poll plus final drain, no duplicates by seq; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: seq-ordered once-only test, mutation-checked, real-process check

handoff.open: A2 live model and A6 UI review need the user

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: atelier run --max-budget-usd x stops a run when priced spend reaches x (G-009)

impact_assessment.why: G-009: an agent driving atelier must be able to bound what one headless run can spend
impact_assessment.benefits: A per-call spend cap, enforced between steps, with a clear blocked reason
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new optional flag, default unchanged; dependency: agent loop reads priceStep results it already computes; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Final answers are never discarded; unpriced models fail closed; mutation-checked tests
